zones.description: List of zone configurations to tell nslint about, typically for DMZs or external references. Each item has 'name' (string) and 'type' (string) and 'file' (string). Use `items` for the structure of list elements.

zones.items.name.description: The domain name of the zone.

zones.items.type.description: The type of the zone (e.g., master).

zones.items.file.description: The file containing the zone data.

networks.description: List of network CIDR or mask strings to check for duplicate A records within the same subnet.

ignore_zones.description: List of zone names to ignore during consistency checks (e.g., dynamic DNS zones).
